import json,pathlib,hashlib
inc=pathlib.Path('/workspace/source/incoming')
rec=json.loads((inc/'handoff-receipt.json').read_text())
print('RECEIPT', rec.get('delivered'), rec.get('sender'), rec.get('recipient'), rec.get('observer_sequence'))
for n,exp in rec['files_sha256'].items():
 dig=hashlib.sha256((inc/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print(('OK' if dig==exp else 'BAD'), n)
man=json.loads((inc/'manifest.json').read_text())
for n in ['RUNNING.txt','native/notify-launch','decision_review.py','agent_observer.py']:
 print(n, man['files_sha256'][n])
rt=hashlib.sha256((inc/'RUNNING.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print('incoming RUNNING', rt, rt==man['files_sha256']['RUNNING.txt'])
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/source')
for name in ['build_release.py','guardian_mcp.py','seccomp_gate.py','decision_review.py','agent_observer.py']:
 print('====', name)
 for i,line in enumerate((root/name).read_text().splitlines(),1):
  if any(k in line for k in ('files_sha256','file_count','policy_version','launch_guard','content_observer','AgentObserver','decision_review','observe(')):
   print(f'{i}:{line[:180]}')
